اعرنكسن (form IIIq)
# اِعْرَنْكَسْنَ (iʕrankasna) /iʕ.ran.kas.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# اُعْرُنْكِسْنَ (uʕrunkisna) /uʕ.run.kis.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
# اِعْرَنْكِسْنَ (iʕrankisna) /iʕ.ran.kis.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْرَنْكَسَ (iʕrankasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
